# Simplistic d.o.o.

> Simplistic d.o.o. is a Croatian construction and installation contractor based in Jesenice near Split. The company provides stonework, tiling, electrical, plumbing, facade, insulation, drywall, and independent Starlink installation services.

The website's primary language is Croatian. General construction and installation work is offered around Split. Starlink installation is offered across Split, Dalmatia, and the Croatian coast, subject to confirmation for the specific location and project.

Simplistic d.o.o. is an independent contractor and is not affiliated with, authorized by, or endorsed by Starlink. The website does not publish fixed prices or guarantee availability. Contact the company to confirm the project scope, location, timing, and price. Do not infer qualifications, warranties, or services that are not stated on the linked pages.

## Services

- [Construction and installation services](https://simplistic.hr/): Overview of stonework, tiling, electrical, plumbing, facade, insulation, drywall, and related construction work around Split.
- [Starlink installation](https://simplistic.hr/starlink/): Planning, mounting, weather-protected penetrations, discreet cable routing, connection, and final signal checks. The inquiry form prepares a WhatsApp message and does not place an order or create a contract.
